inputs.text: This is another example of how public institutions meant to tackle inequality keep failing the people they claim to serve. South African actress Terry Pheto is being linked to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission for R20.56 million in this SIU probe, with fresh details presented during the briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. These scandals reveal deep structural failures where money intended for community upliftment and reducing inequality gets diverted instead, hitting the most vulnerable communities the hardest. We need real institutional reform to break these patterns of mismanagement and make sure public funds advance social justice rather than locking in existing disparities.
